title: Byte Episode: You Have a Degree. So Why Can't You Get a Job?

endingNote.note: line 26 ends on an open question — hold the silence, then cut to black, nothing after

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: My degree's framed in my parents' hallway. I walk past it to ask for rent.
lines.emotion: Ashamed, and practised at hiding it — they've turned it into a dry observation so it won't sound like a confession, and it still costs them
lines.subtext: I'm the quiet joke of my own house, and nobody says it.
lines.delivery: Flat, almost conversational; the second sentence quieter than the first
lines.face: A half-smile that never reaches the eyes; on "rent" the jaw tightens and the smile goes flat; one visible swallow after the line
lines.eyes: Down and to the side, as if looking at the hallway
lines.body: Hands buried in hoodie pocket, shoulders slightly raised
lines.reaction: Byte's screen-eyes widen a fraction, then soften; antenna dips
lines.visualNote: Slow push-in on Human. Brief cutaway: a framed degree on a hallway wall, slightly crooked, under a dim ceiling light.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: How many?
lines.emotion: Quietly attentive — choosing not to comfort yet, because comfort this early would sound cheap
lines.subtext: I'm not going to look away. Tell me the real number.
lines.delivery: Soft and simple, no sympathy voice
lines.face: Screen-eyes level and steady, small neutral mouth line, one slow blink
lines.body: Cube tilts forward a few degrees
lines.reaction: Human lets out a short breath through the nose — the "you really want to know?" exhale

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: Two hundred and twelve. Forty said no. The rest said nothing.
lines.emotion: Numb precision — they know the exact number because they check it at night, and reciting it is easier than feeling it
lines.subtext: I count them because counting is the only part I control.
lines.delivery: Recited like an inventory; the last sentence drops away
lines.pacing: Normal, slowing on the last sentence
lines.tone: Hollow, matter-of-fact, fraying at the end
lines.face: Mouth barely moving on the numbers; after "nothing" the lips press together and the chin dimples slightly
lines.eyes: Fixed on a point somewhere past Byte
lines.body: Thumb rubbing the side of the index finger
lines.reaction: Byte's screen dims a shade; eyes lower
lines.visualNote: Faint phone glow on Human's face; an empty inbox, out of focus.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: The nothing is the worst part.
lines.emotion: Grave recognition — not consoling, agreeing, because agreeing is the kindest thing available
lines.subtext: You're not being dramatic. Silence is a real kind of rejection.
lines.delivery: Quiet and plain, no lift at the end
lines.face: Screen-eyes lowered to half-lids; mouth a short flat line
lines.eyes: Down, then back up to Human on "worst"
lines.body: Antenna droops slightly
lines.reaction: Human's eyes flick to Byte for the first time — surprised to be agreed with

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: My friends post offer letters. I like every one.
lines.emotion: Brittle cheerfulness over envy — trying to sound like a good friend, and it comes out as a confession
lines.subtext: I'm happy for them, and I hate how much it hurts.
lines.delivery: Too bright on the first sentence; the second sags
lines.tone: Forced lightness, catching on the last word
lines.face: Brows lifted in a performed "it's fine"; a quick tight smile that holds a beat too long, then drops
lines.eyes: At Byte, then away on "every one"
lines.body: Thumb mimes a tap on an invisible phone
lines.reaction: Byte's screen-eyes curve into gentle crescents — it sees straight through the smile

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: And you mean it. Mostly.
lines.emotion: Knowing tenderness — letting them off the hook by naming the thing they're ashamed of
lines.subtext: You're allowed to be jealous. It doesn't make you a bad friend.
lines.delivery: Warm; a tiny beat before "Mostly", which lands dry
lines.face: One screen-eye narrows slightly on "Mostly"; mouth a small lopsided curve
lines.body: Cube tilts to one side
lines.reaction: Human gives a short, caught half-laugh through the nose and looks down — busted

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: I did everything. Four years. The gown. The photo.
lines.emotion: Grievance building — listing it is like counting debts nobody is going to repay
lines.subtext: I kept my side of the deal.
lines.delivery: Each item its own sentence, each landing harder; "The photo" comes out bitter
lines.face: Brows drawing together item by item; nostrils flare on "The gown"; upper lip curls slightly on "The photo"
lines.body: Ticks the items off on their fingers, then the hand drops
lines.reaction: Byte stays completely still, eyes steady — listening, not waiting to talk
lines.visualNote: Quick flash-cuts on each beat, under half a second each: a lecture hall, a graduation cap, a posed grad photo on a phone screen.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: You followed the map.
lines.emotion: Respect — acknowledging the effort, offering no lesson yet
lines.subtext: You did nothing wrong.
lines.delivery: Simple, confirming
lines.face: Eyes open fully; a small upward curve, not a smile
lines.body: Cube dips forward once, a nod
lines.reaction: Human's jaw shifts sideways — the acknowledgement makes it worse, not better

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: So where's the part where it works?
lines.emotion: Bitter sarcasm — anger hiding inside a joke
lines.subtext: Somebody lied to me, and I want to know who.
lines.delivery: Mock-curious, then the edge shows through on "works"
lines.face: One brow up, a flat sarcastic smile; the eyes aren't smiling at all
lines.body: Arms open slightly, palms up
lines.reaction: Byte blinks once, slowly — not offended, considering

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: Want to know what they're actually asking?
lines.emotion: Careful — Byte has something useful, and knows it's walking onto a bruise
lines.subtext: I'm about to say something you might not like. I'd rather you let me.
lines.delivery: Gentle, genuinely asking permission
lines.face: Screen-eyes lift slightly, open and patient
lines.body: Antenna rises
lines.reaction: Human folds their arms — bracing

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: Go on.
lines.emotion: Guarded — sick of advice, but desperate enough to listen
lines.subtext: If this is "just network more", I'm done.
lines.delivery: Reluctant, clipped, a short beat before speaking
lines.face: Lips pressed thin; eyes narrowed slightly
lines.body: Arms stay folded, weight shifts back onto heels
lines.reaction: none

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: Your degree answers one question. Could you do this job?
lines.emotion: Clear and steady — teaching now, but still on Human's side
lines.subtext: The degree did its job. It just answers a question nobody's leading with.
lines.delivery: Measured, a small lift on the question
lines.face: Eyes bright and attentive
lines.body: Cube turns slightly toward Human
lines.reaction: Human's brows twitch — obviously yes, where's this going

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: Yes. That's the whole point.
lines.emotion: Defensive certainty — protecting four years from being called a waste
lines.subtext: Don't you dare tell me it was for nothing.
lines.delivery: Quick and firm
lines.face: Chin up, brows down, mouth tight
lines.body: One arm unfolds to gesture sharply at nothing
lines.reaction: Byte gives a small acknowledging blink — agreeing, not arguing

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: They're asking something else. Have you? Can I see it?
lines.emotion: Quiet certainty — this is the turn, and Byte keeps its voice low so it doesn't land as a gotcha
lines.subtext: It's not that you aren't good enough. It's that they can't see it yet.
lines.delivery: Slower; real space between "Have you?" and "Can I see it?"
lines.face: Screen-eyes widen slightly on "see"
lines.body: Completely still — letting the words sit
lines.reaction: Human goes still for a beat; the realisation lands before the anger does
lines.visualNote: The overlay COULD YOU? swaps to HAVE YOU?

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: How do I get experience if nobody gives me a chance?
lines.emotion: Furious, but it's really terror — shouting because if Byte is right, the trap has no exit
lines.subtext: Don't make this my fault. I can't carry it being my fault.
lines.delivery: Loud; the voice cracks upward on "chance"
lines.face: Brows slammed together, teeth showing on "nobody", eyes wet but not crying; jaw clamps shut at the end
lines.body: Steps forward, both hands out, palms open
lines.reaction: Byte doesn't flinch; eyes stay level and soft
lines.visualNote: Camera snaps in tight on Human.

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: It's a locked door. And the key's on the other side.
lines.emotion: The anger draining into despair — the shout is spent, and what's left is the actual fear
lines.subtext: I'm stuck, and I'm scared I'll be stuck for good.
lines.delivery: Much quieter, almost to themselves
lines.face: Brows lift and pinch together in the middle; the jaw unclenches; lower lip pressed under the teeth to stop it moving
lines.body: Hands fall to their sides; shoulders cave
lines.reaction: Byte's screen dims; antenna lowers all the way
lines.visualNote: Ambient sound drops out. Hold on Human through the full pause.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: I know. That part is real. It's not in your head. And you didn't cause it.
lines.emotion: Still and solemn — no teaching at all, just standing beside them
lines.subtext: Before anything else: this is not a verdict on you.
lines.delivery: Very slow, each sentence on its own, nothing rising
lines.face: Screen-eyes soft and level; mouth a gentle flat line
lines.eyes: At Human, even though Human isn't looking back
lines.body: Cube drifts a little closer
lines.reaction: On "you didn't cause it", Human's chin trembles once and they blink hard — the tell right before tears, caught in time
lines.visualNote: Wide two-shot, both characters small in frame.

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: Then what am I supposed to do?
lines.emotion: Disarmed exhaustion — the fight is gone, and asking for help feels less humiliating than it did a minute ago
lines.subtext: Okay. I'm listening. Properly this time.
lines.delivery: Quiet and plain, a real question, not rhetorical
lines.face: A long exhale through the mouth before speaking; eyes red-rimmed; brows relaxed for the first time in the episode
lines.body: Sinks down to sit on a step or ledge
lines.reaction: Byte's screen brightens slightly — relief

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: Two people. Same degree. One gets the call.
lines.emotion: Gently curious — setting up a puzzle for Human to solve, not delivering a lecture
lines.subtext: There is a difference, and it isn't talent.
lines.delivery: Rhythmic, even beats
lines.face: Eyes bright, one sitting slightly higher than the other — intrigued
lines.body: Antenna bobs once on each beat
lines.reaction: Human's eyes narrow — already suspicious of the answer
lines.visualNote: Two identical simple silhouettes side by side; one lights up.

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: Let me guess. Her uncle.
lines.emotion: Wry cynicism — humour as armour now the anger's spent
lines.subtext: I need it to be something I couldn't have done.
lines.delivery: Dry, deadpan
lines.face: One corner of the mouth pulled sideways; brows flat
lines.body: Small one-shoulder shrug
lines.reaction: Byte's eyes go half-lidded — amused

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: Sometimes. Uncles are undefeated.
lines.emotion: Dry amusement — conceding the point honestly, which is exactly why it's funny
lines.subtext: I'm not going to pretend the world is fair.
lines.delivery: Deadpan, quick, no wink
lines.face: A tiny flat smile on the screen; one eye squints
lines.body: Antenna droops in mock defeat
lines.reaction: Human laughs — a real, surprised one, the first of the episode; a hand comes up to the face

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: But usually? She didn't say she could. She showed them.
lines.emotion: Sincere — the joke opened a door, and Byte walks through it gently
lines.subtext: This part is in your hands.
lines.delivery: Softer after the joke; slow on "showed them"
lines.face: The smile fades into a calm, open look; eyes level
lines.body: Cube settles, still
lines.reaction: Human's laugh fades mid-line; the face goes quiet, listening

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: Show them what? I've got nothing.
lines.emotion: Exposed — the old shame is back, but this time it's an honest question, not an attack
lines.subtext: This is what I'm actually afraid of: that there's nothing there.
lines.delivery: Starts sharp; the second sentence falls quiet
lines.face: Brows pinched upward; a quick bite of the lower lip after; eyes look away a beat too late
lines.body: Hands rub together between the knees
lines.reaction: Byte's head tilts and its eyes soften — it expected this

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: Pick one job you want. Do one small piece of it. Send it with your application.
lines.emotion: Practical warmth — handing over something deliberately small so it feels possible
lines.subtext: Not a portfolio. Not a five-year plan. One thing.
lines.delivery: Unhurried, each sentence a single step
lines.face: Eyes bright and steady; a small, sure mouth
lines.body: Antenna straightens upright
lines.reaction: Human's eyes start moving — thinking it through; a small frown of concentration
lines.visualNote: Simple graphic: a job listing card, with a small file icon sliding onto it.

lines.speaker: human
lines.text: That's it?
lines.emotion: Wary hope — it sounds too small to work, which is exactly why they want to believe it
lines.subtext: Don't make me hope again unless you mean it.
lines.delivery: Quiet, half a laugh in it
lines.face: Brows slightly raised; mouth unsure, not quite a smile; eyes lift to Byte
lines.body: Leans forward a little, elbows on knees
lines.reaction: Byte's eyes crinkle warmly

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: If they asked to see it, what would you show them?
lines.emotion: Open curiosity — genuinely wants the answer, with no lesson attached
lines.subtext: I'm not asking them. I'm asking you.
lines.delivery: Gentle; a real question that rises at the end
lines.face: Eyes wide, open, expectant
lines.body: Cube rotates to face camera
lines.reaction: Human goes completely still, eyes unfocused — thinking, with no answer
lines.visualNote: Byte turns to camera on the final words. Hold the silence, then cut to black.
